title: The empty van
caption: I bought a Chevy Express cargo van, sold the shelving and dividers, and vacuumed the whole bay at a car wash until it was back to bare metal. An empty box — and the start of everything.

title: Sound deadening
caption: Kilmat on the panels first: the quiet layer you never see once the walls go up, but you hear it on every drive.

title: The floor
caption: Templated the floor with Amazon boxes and paper bags, cut XPS foam and then a full plywood sheet with a jigsaw, and test-fit until the edges were right. The moment the floor went down, the box suddenly felt like a room.

title: A hole in the roof
caption: First time cutting into a roof — a little nervous. A frame from leftover wood, pilot holes, a jigsaw, butyl tape to seal. Not just ventilation: the line where a work truck starts becoming a home.

title: Wiring & insulation
caption: I sketched the 12V wiring on kraft paper first — planning the runs felt a lot like motion planning. Then Havelock wool over the ceiling and walls, held with nylon rope and 3M spray. Every redo was just the search for a better way.

title: Solar & finish
caption: A solar panel for power, and the plywood sealed and stained. Slow, but every layer is taking shape.

title: On the road
caption: Then out to Joshua Tree — the reason for all of it. Open desert, a warm glow through the windows at dusk, a chair set up inside. Still a build in progress, already a life on the road.
